details.question: How is the CloudWay 24 Armed Forces Discount different from other promotional offers?
details.reference_answer: The armed forces discount is applicable only on base fare, not including taxes, surcharges or add-ons. It is not combinable with other promotional offers.

details.question: How do I avail the CloudWay 24 Armed Forces Discount?
details.reference_answer:
1. Sign Up / Login with your email or mobile on CloudWay24.com or the CloudWay24 App (iOS/Android).
2. Select “Plan My Flight” and enter your round trip or one-way details.
3. On the passenger details page, choose “Armed Forces Discount” and upload valid service/retirement ID proof.
4. Proceed to payment — discounted fare and baggage benefits will be automatically applied.
5. Complete booking using credit/debit card, netbanking, or SkyPoints 24 points.

details.question: Who is eligible for the CloudWay 24 Armed Forces Discount?
details.reference_answer:
Serving Personnel of the Indian Army, Navy, Air Force, Coast Guard, and Paramilitary Forces.
Retired/ Ex-Servicemen of the above services.
Immediate Family Members (spouse and dependent children) when traveling with the eligible personnel.

details.question: What benefits are included in CloudWay 24's Armed Forces Discount Program?

Applicable for CloudSaver (Economy), CloudComfort (Premium Economy), and CloudElite (Business Class) fares.

details.question: How do I cancel a booking with CloudWay 24?
details.reference_answer:

**CloudWay 24 Mobile App (iOS/Android)**: Open the app, log in, go to **Manage My Flight**, tap **Cancel Your Booking**, select your trip, and confirm.

details.question: How are visa policies different for Singapore and Thailand for Indian citizens?
details.reference_answer:
Singapore requires Indian citizens to obtain an e-visa before travel, and there is no visa-on-arrival option available. Proof of funds, a return ticket, and hotel booking are necessary.

In contrast, Thailand offers a visa-on-arrival for Indian citizens for up to 15 days with a fee, limited entry points, and also has an e-visa option. Requirements include proof of accommodation, funds, and a return ticket.

details.question: How can an Indian citizen apply for a visa to Japan?
details.reference_answer: All Indian citizens must obtain a visa in advance from the Japanese embassy or consulate. Required documents include an invitation letter or travel itinerary, a bank statement, and a return ticket.

details.question: Do Indian citizens need a visa to enter Nepal?
details.reference_answer: Indian citizens do not need a visa to enter Nepal. They must carry a valid passport or election ID.

details.question: As of now, how long can Indian citizens stay visa-free in Hong Kong?
details.reference_answer: Indian citizens can stay in Hong Kong visa-free for up to 14 days after completing mandatory pre-arrival online registration.

details.question: Why is travel insurance strongly recommended for Asian destinations?
details.reference_answer: Travel insurance is strongly recommended for Asian destinations because it provides financial protection against potential risks like medical emergencies, trip cancellations, or loss of belongings. Some destinations even mandate insurance for entry.

details.question: How does the Airbus A380 compare to other passenger aircraft in terms of capacity?
details.reference_answer: The Airbus A380 is the world’s largest passenger airliner, offering unmatched space with its double-deck design. It typically seats 500–575 passengers and can be configured to accommodate up to 853 in an all-economy layout.

details.question: What are the main features of the Airbus A380's First Class?
details.reference_answer: First Class features fully flat suites with privacy doors, offering personal suites with lie-flat beds, direct aisle access, luxury amenity kits, designer bedding, personal wardrobe storage, a private minibar, in-seat power and USB charging, 32-40” HD entertainment screens, access to an onboard lounge/bar (on select airlines), and fine-dining menus served on demand.

details.question: What are the cabin features available in the Airbus A380's Economy Class?
details.reference_answer: In Economy Class, seating is configured with a pitch of 31–33” and a width of 18–18.5”. The class includes adjustable headrests, personal 10–13” HD screens, hundreds of movies, music, games, complimentary meals and beverages, family and bassinet seating options, and power outlets on select fleets.

details.question: Why might airlines choose to use the Airbus A380 for long-haul routes?
details.reference_answer: The Airbus A380 offers a wide-body design, optimizing both capacity and passenger experience with its advanced aerodynamics and efficient engines. Its spacious cabins, reduced noise levels, mood lighting, wide aisles, larger lavatories, and additional features like onboard bars/lounges make it ideal for enhancing long-haul travel comfort.

details.question: How does the insurance coverage for non-ground staff differ from ground staff at CloudWay 24?
details.reference_answer:
CloudWay 24 provides comprehensive group insurance coverage for all employees, ensuring their health, safety, and well-being while on duty and beyond. Insurance benefits are categorized based on employee roles due to the varying risk profiles associated with their responsibilities.

For non-ground staff (Pilots & Cabin Crew), there is enhanced coverage due to higher occupational risk. This includes higher limits on group life insurance, accidental death & disability, and critical illness cover. A unique feature for pilots is the loss of license benefit, and there is comprehensive global travel insurance.

For ground staff (Engineering, HR, Administration, Support Services), the coverage reflects relatively lower occupational exposure, with lower insurance limits and no loss of license benefit. Travel insurance is domestic and limited to international work travel.

details.question: What is included in CloudWay 24's insurance policy for Pilots and Cabin Crew?
details.reference_answer: CloudWay 24 provides enhanced coverage for pilots and cabin crew due to their higher occupational risk. This includes INR 1.5 Crore for group life insurance, INR 2 Crore for accidental death & disability, INR 10 Lakh for medical insurance per annum, and INR 20 Lakh for critical illness cover. Pilots have a loss of license benefit up to INR 1 Crore. The travel insurance is comprehensive and global.

details.question: How can CloudWay 24 employees file an insurance claim?
details.reference_answer: All claims are facilitated by the Corporate HR and Employee Well-being Department in partnership with leading insurance providers. Employees can also access the CloudWay 24 Employee Portal or contact HR at hr@cloudway24.com for latest updates or claims.

details.question: When is CloudWay 24's insurance policy reviewed and updated?
details.reference_answer: Insurance limits and coverage are reviewed annually as per regulatory standards and operational requirements.

details.question: What additional benefits does CloudWay 24 offer to employees' families?
details.reference_answer: Medical insurance can be extended to spouse and dependent children at preferential group rates.

details.question: How do I modify my trip dates on CloudWay 24?
details.reference_answer:
CloudWay 24 understands that plans can change. If you need to modify your trip dates after booking your ticket, the process is simple and can be done conveniently through the CloudWay 24 website or mobile app.

### Steps to Modify Your Trip Dates
1. Log In: Visit [CloudWay24.com](https://CloudWay24.com) or open the CloudWay 24 app. Log in using your email or mobile number and password.
2. Access "Manage My Flight": Navigate to the "Manage My Flight" section from the homepage or main menu.
3. Retrieve Your Booking: Enter your booking reference number (PNR) and last name, or log in to view your bookings. Select the booking you wish to modify.
4. Select "Modify Your Booking": Click on the "Modify Your Booking" option. Choose "Change Trip Dates" from the available modification options.
5. Choose New Dates: Select your new preferred departure (and return, if applicable) dates. Review available flights and seat options for your new travel dates.
6. Review Changes: Compare the current and new flight details. Any fare differences or change fees, according to your ticket rules, will be displayed.
7. Confirm and Pay: Agree to any additional charges if applicable (fare difference/change fee). Choose your payment option (credit card, debit card, netbanking, or SkyPoints 24 points). Complete the payment.
8. Receive Confirmation: You will receive a confirmation email and/or SMS with your updated travel itinerary.

details.question: How can I book a flight with a pet on CloudWay 24?
details.reference_answer: To book a flight with a pet on CloudWay 24, you should select "Travelling with Pets" during your flight booking and enter your pet's details. After booking, use the "Manage My Flight" feature and choose "Add a Pet" or contact Customer Care. Pet travel fees can be paid online using Credit Card, Debit Card, Netbanking, or SkyPoints 24 points.

details.question: What are the requirements for pet carriers on CloudWay 24 flights?
details.reference_answer: For in-cabin travel, carriers must be soft-sided, leak-proof, well-ventilated, and fit under the seat. For checked baggage, carriers should be rigid, have a secure latch, absorbent bedding, and provide enough room for your pet to stand, turn, and lie down comfortably. All carriers must have an identification tag with the pet’s name and contact info.

details.question: Are pets allowed in CloudWay 24's First Class?
details.reference_answer: No, pets are not allowed in CloudLux (First Class) on CloudWay 24 flights due to space limitations.

details.question: Why might certain pets not be allowed in the hold on CloudWay 24 flights?
details.reference_answer: Brachycephalic breeds, which are flat-faced dogs and cats, may not be allowed in the hold for safety reasons. These breeds can have respiratory issues, especially in the confined and pressurized environment of an airplane hold, posing a risk to their health during transport.

details.question: How do the in-cabin and checked baggage pet travel options differ on CloudWay 24?
details.reference_answer: In-cabin pet travel is available on select international routes with durations under 8 hours and allows pets weighing up to 8 kg, including the carrier. The carrier should be soft-sided and fit under a seat. Checked baggage pet travel is available on all direct international flights for pets weighing up to 32 kg, including the carrier, which must be rigid and secure. The fees also differ, with in-cabin costing USD 150 and checked baggage costing USD 250.

details.question: How do I report damaged baggage at the airport with CloudWay 24?
details.reference_answer: At the Airport: Report immediately to the CloudWay 24 Baggage Service Desk before leaving the arrival hall. Fill out the Damaged Baggage Claim Form with our representative. Provide your boarding pass, bag tags, and a valid photo ID.

details.question: Does CloudWay 24 cover minor scratches on luggage?
details.reference_answer: Not Covered: Minor scratches, scuffs, or dents consistent with normal handling.

details.question: Why does CloudWay 24 require reporting of baggage damage within 7 days?
details.reference_answer: After Leaving the Airport: If you notice the damage after leaving, report it in writing within 7 days of receiving your baggage. Claims after this period are excluded.

details.question: How does CloudWay 24’s compensation policy differ for damaged baggage?
details.reference_answer: Our Compensation Policy: CloudWay 24 will evaluate the extent and cause of the damage. Offer a repair service, replacement bag, or financial compensation (as per international conventions and airline policy). Compensation may vary depending on the level of damage, bag age, and documentation provided. CloudWay 24’s liability for damaged baggage is limited as per the Montreal Convention and company policy.

details.question: What steps does CloudWay 24 suggest for managing baggage concerns?
details.reference_answer: Helpful Tips: Keep your bag tags and receipts until the end of your journey. Inspect your baggage immediately upon collection. Use name labels on your baggage.

details.question: What is the CloudWay 24 Employee Free Tickets Policy?
details.reference_answer: All full-time CloudWay 24 employees are eligible for 4 round-trip international tickets per calendar year. These can be used by the employee or together for family travel. details.question: How do I notify CloudWay 24 about carrying a hunting rifle?
details.reference_answer: Advance notification is mandatory for firearms and includes valid firearm licenses and documentation. Submit requests via “Manage My Flight” or contact CloudWay 24 Customer Service at least 72 hours before departure.

details.question: Does CloudWay 24 allow musical instruments as cabin baggage?
details.reference_answer: Yes, small musical instruments (up to 115 cm/45 in and 7kg) are allowed as cabin baggage, subject to space and safety conditions.

details.question: What might be the reasons for advance notice requirements for oversized sports equipment?
details.reference_answer: Oversized sports equipment requires advance notice to ensure proper packing and handling of fragile items and to arrange for necessary space and safety measures. This facilitates efficient management and reduces the risk of damage.

details.question: What are the packing guidelines for rifles and ammunition on CloudWay 24?
details.reference_answer: Rifles must be unloaded, dismantled if possible, and packed in rigid locked cases. Ammunition is limited to 5 kg per passenger, packed separately from firearms, in manufacturer’s packaging, adhering to local and international regulations.
